question: Date the RCF default switch: list archived captures of rcf.donorfirstx.com/pdf/RCF/Donor%20User%20Guide.pdf and the 2309-RCF-FRM-DAF-DONORGUIDE template (tda/ubs portals) with the archive.org availability API (robots-checked), and record when the acknowledgement text changed from 'The default is Fund Name Only' to 'By default, this includes the grant advisor's name, email, and address'
conclusion_affected: Whether the RCF full-contact default is a 2026 platform change or an older RCF choice; reading of the b44n28-01 §3.2 'sponsor setting' inference
rationale: Two RCF guides on the same UBS portal give opposite defaults (2024-06 'Fund Name Only'; 2026-10 name, email and address). A capture history would date the switch and show whether it coincided with the 'Giving Platform' guide

question: Same-version test for non-RCF sponsors: each month, hash the guides linked from msgift.donorfirstx.com, bofa.donorfirst.org and cjp.donorfirstx.com and flag when any of them links the 'Giving Platform Donor User Guide' (current SHA-1 prefix 93d97b49e84a) or a new guide; when one does, record its stated acknowledgement default

question: Which governs the grant letter, the UI default or the letter policy? rationale: Five programs carry two first-party texts that imply different defaults; the CSV codes the newer or more specific text and records the other in other_quote
